$comment: Pin of StaticSitesClient, Microsoft's deploy client that the Static Web Apps CLI runs (eng/deploy/install-tools.sh). sha256 was computed from a download on 2026-11-19 and matched Microsoft's metadata at https://aka.ms/swalocaldeploy (tags stable and latest then). Licence: Microsoft, closed source, no licence text in the binary; not on the ADR-050 list. The owner's approval is recorded in eng/deploy/licences.json for this buildId only; DeployToolRules fails when the pin changes without a new approval there. To update: read the metadata, download the linux-x64 file, compare its SHA-256 with the metadata, and change buildId, url and sha256 here in a pull request (owner review, CODEOWNERS).
